source: Kenya Demographic and Health Survey (KDHS) 2022, Kids' Recode (KR) file
source_access: restricted -- obtained via an approved data request to The DHS Program (dhsprogram.com); the raw microdata file is not redistributable and is not committed to this repository
extracted_from: rendered output committed at project7-setup merge commit 147a75d (see git history), read 2026-07-28
methodology: Youngest living child per mother kept per household. Stunting defined as height-for-age z-score (HAZ) < -2 SD, WHO 2006 growth reference standards. Estimates are survey-weighted (v005) and account for the two-stage cluster sample design (primary sampling unit = v021, strata = v022).

national.stunting_prevalence_ci_note: not computed in the source analysis (table statistic was n (%) only, no CI requested)

subnational.note: County-level prevalence with 95% CIs is written in notebooks/task2_regional_indicators.qmd (svyby + svyciprop by county, merged to a Kenya counties shapefile via rKenyaCensus) but the rendered output image was never committed to git, and the current HTML render predates this code being added. Re-running that chunk and exporting stunting_county (county, prevalence, lb, ub) to CSV would make this section real.

not_yet_analysed: immunisation coverage (code present in the .qmd but incomplete/contains a syntax error -- the fully_vaccinated ifelse() is missing its TRUE/FALSE branches)
wealth quintile breakdown (no wealth-quintile variable used anywhere in the current analysis)
